description: The line plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) for three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—across a range of generation temperatures from 0.1 to 1.0. The x-axis, labeled “Temperature,” spans from 0.1 to 1.0 with linear spacing and tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” ranges from 62.5 to 80.0, also with linear spacing and tick marks every 2.5 units. The “On-policy RL” method (orange line with triangle markers) begins at approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1, peaks around 75.0 at 0.8, and ends near 73.5 at 1.0, showing a generally increasing trend with fluctuations. The “LUFFY” method (red line with star markers) starts at 76.0, rises to a peak of about 80.0 at 0.8, and ends slightly above 80.0 at 1.0, maintaining high performance with minor dips. The “SFT” method (teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers) begins at 76.0, dips to 70.0 at 0.5, recovers to 76.0 at 0.6, and ends at 74.5 at 1.0, exhibiting a more volatile pattern with a pronounced valley near the middle of the temperature range. All three lines are connected with solid lines and use distinct markers for visual differentiation.
